- Open your email and search for the store name or “laptop stand”.
- Open the confirmation email for today’s purchase.
- Look for something labeled “Order ID”, “Order #”, or “Confirmation #” (often near the top or in the header).

2) From your account on the store’s site/app
- Go to your account → “Orders” or “Purchases”.
- Open the order from today (2025-10-25) for the laptop stand.
- The order number/ID should be shown at the top of the order details screen.

- Check if it’s still within the cancellation window (very likely since it’s from today).
- Cancel the entire order for the laptop stand.
- Tell you the cancellation confirmation code and refund amount/timing.

If you want to try canceling directly in the meantime, open that order in your account and look for a “Cancel order” button—since it’s a single-item order, you’d choose “Cancel entire order” and confirm.</action>
